WOOCOMMERCE / ORIGINAL NATIVE CHECKOUT

Prepare your merchant connection.

Import saved product routes or exact basket catalogs from WooCommerce. Review unit prices and retained versions, then prepare the original seller, buyer, delivery service and merchant agent.

woo-merchant0 ROUTES · 0 CATALOGS

Complete these items.

    Import your saved merchant exports.

    For a saved product, use Download saved merchant route. For digital baskets, save the approved products and endpoint in the original gateway settings, then use Download this exact basket catalog. Retain up to 32 catalog versions for pending orders alongside up to 64 legacy routes.

    First installation? Prepare the original Woo plugin.

    Download the local preparation tool, select your complete Stellar Forge checkout or installed source package, and copy its complete original 16-file plugin folder into WordPress. Activate the plugin, save the product mapping and gateway settings, then import the route or catalog here. The included INSTALL.md covers those steps.

    Catalogs retain the declared storefront unit price and exact native atomic price. Woo freezes the actual product lines, quantities, tax-inclusive total and delivery definitions into each order. Open a catalog to review every approved product and its unit terms.

    Exports stay in this page until you download a draft or packet. Select the original product routes and catalog exports here. Customer order handoffs and private keys belong in the original buyer and merchant tools.

    Connect the existing shop and seller.

    Use the actual shop, facilitator and private service directory. The saved exports already declare the seller origin, methods, assets and recipients. A catalog update keeps the merchant’s original delivery outbox.

    A name for the downloaded ZIP and its editable files.

    The exact store that exported these product IDs. Use an origin without a path.

    For WordPress in a subdirectory, enter its actual same-origin REST URL. The settlement receiver uses the same REST base.

    Use the facilitator selected for the routes’ actual network. No credentials in this field.

    An absolute path on your Linux merchant host, outside public web files. Preparation creates this directory and refuses an existing one.

    Use the merchant’s original outbox when adding catalog versions. It must already exist and remains at the same path. Leave this empty for a new merchant’s first outbox.

    Define the PHP constant SF98_WEBHOOK_SECRET in wp-config.php from the private key, and set the same value in the native seller and delivery-worker environments. The setup packet contains no key. The original PHP plugin requires WooCommerce, PHP 8.0+ and real MySQL/MariaDB named locks.

    Review the exact merchant setup.

    Route and catalog files retain their imported bytes. Catalog digests are checked here, and the original native compiler checks their full terms before preparing the private merchant configuration.

    Run the original tools and release the order.

    The ZIP includes complete merchant, buyer and agent instructions. Use the same private configuration, outbox and buyer ledger when restarting or recovering an order.

    LOCAL PREPARATION · NO STORE REQUEST OR PAYMENT FROM THIS PAGE

    One order, retained through delivery.

    Classic and Blocks checkout

    The original gateway creates an unpaid on-hold order and a private buyer handoff bound to its frozen product lines, exact aggregate and attempt generation.

    Native buyer and settlement

    The original buyer reviews the live offer and retains its approval, signer, budget and ledger. The shop admits one verified native attempt for the current order.

    Merchant review and release

    The original delivery worker records its signed notice in WooCommerce. After independent reconciliation, the merchant releases the order through Woo’s own completion and download permissions.
